title: Stability exit scribe and pin notes
content:
Purpose: quick, messy working notes for 'exit' criteria and pin decisions during small-cohort canary ramps. Not a runbook — this is my scratchpad for the next few roll windows.

Context: rolling a minor model revision (v3.2.1 -> v3.3.0-quant) on hosted and dedicated pools. Primary worry: a small distribution shift early in prompts causing hallucination spikes and throughput variance on 2s p95 paths. We want low-friction pin/fallback rules and clear signals to flip.

Main objectives (in priority order):
- Prevent user-visible quality regressions (content-level hallucinations / toxicity)
- Keep latency SLO (p95 <= 600ms for short-path clients) or auto-hit fallback
- Avoid flapping: prefer stable pins for 10-30m windows unless clear regression

Warmup plan (fractional exposure):
- Step 0: shadow (0% traffic) for 1h to collect baseline token-level perf and mem stats.
- Step 1: 0.5% steady traffic for 10m
- Step 2: 2% for 20m
- Step 3: 8% for 30m
- Step 4: 25% for 40m -> evaluate and decide next (go to 50% or rollback)

Cohort selection: pick low-risk customers (see cohort list in Confluence suggested links) + internal canary accounts (team dev keys). Exclude: live billing flows, latency-sensitive callouts, high-rate tenants.

Primary telemetry to watch (quick queries I want in the Watch dashboard):
- Latency: p50/p95/p99 per model variant, per region, per client-tier. Quick PromQL suggestions:
  - latency_p95{model=\"v3.3.0-quant\",region!=\"eu\"} / latency_p95{model=\"v3.2.1\",region!=\"eu\"}
  - error_rate{model=~\"v3.*\"} by (model)
- Quality regressions: rate of user-reported hallucinations (post-hoc signals) + automated regressions via small prompt-eval set (10 canonical prompts). Run quick batch eval every 10m.
- Safety signals: toxicity classifier score > 0.8 fraction by model.
- Resource patterns: GPU mem pressure (per-pod), backend OOM count, queue length.
- Cost/throughput: tokens/sec per replica and average token latency.

Alert thresholds (soft alarms vs hard):
- SOFT (notify #release-watch, auto-show in dashboard):
  - p95 latency increase > 30% vs baseline sustained for 5m
  - eval-score regression delta > 6% (on the 10-prompt set)
  - safety-flag rate increase x3 vs baseline (for any region)
- HARD (immediate pin/fallback/eng pager):
  - p95 latency > 2x baseline or > 1200ms for 2m
  - production errors > 1% of requests in a 1m window
  - classifier safety flags > 5% or any verified high-severity hallucination reported by CS

Pin & fallback policy (decision tree shorthand):
- If HARD triggers -> immediate pinback to previous stable variant for all cohorts (automated) + postmortem ticket created automatically. Notify #release-ops, #sre, owner.
- If SOFT triggers -> hold at current fraction and open quick investigation checklist. If unresolved after 15m escalate to manual pin.
- Manual pin action: route 100% of canary cohort back to v3.2.1 and mark canary slot draining, keep dedicated capacity isolated for 30m to observe.

Pin duration heuristics:
- Short flip: if transient (< 10m) and low-severity, allow auto-recover (no pin) but record event.
- Conservative pin: when human-verified quality regression -> pin for at least 60m and do a deeper test.

Rollback playbook (scratch checklist):
- Who: owner/secondary on call -> perform pin and confirm routing rules applied.
- Steps: 1) Execute infra rollback route -> set route weights 100/0 for canary cohort. 2) Re-run 10 canonical prompts against canary cohort to confirm quality restored. 3) Check metrics (latency, errors) for 30m. 4) Open retro ticket and label JIRA-RELEASE-4012 with tags.

Communication snippets (for Slack / release-watch):
- Soft alert template: "+ALERT+ Observed p95 rise ~35% for v3.3.0-quant on us-west; investigating. Holding at 8% traffic. @RaviP tracking. ETA 15m."
- Hard alert template: "+ACTION REQUIRED+ p95 x2 and errors >1% for v3.3.0-quant; pinning canary cohort back to v3.2.1. Owner: Imani V. See JIRA-RELEASE-4012."

Quick checks to run before starting warmup (preflight):
- CI: perf tests green on infra PR (PR 189)
- Nightly eval score delta < 2% vs baseline on full eval harness
- Canary cohort list updated and consent flags set
- Auto-fallback config validated (dry-run)

Open questions / TODOs (investigate before next window):
- How noisy are the 10-canonical prompts vs real world? Need to expand to 30 but keep fast.
- Should we route EU traffic to a separate canary window to avoid GDPR churn? (probably yes)
- Confirm who has authority to pin outside business hours (define escalation matrix).

Notes / random thoughts:
- Consider an "intermediate pin" (e.g., route 90% to old model, 10% new) instead of full 0/100 to see residual errors while minimizing impact. Might reduce thrash.
- If mem pressure always spikes after warmup step 3, try reducing max-batch or enabling kv-cache priming earlier.

Post-window checklist (what I want to paste into the retro ticket):
- Traffic ramp timeline with timestamps
- All alarm traces URLs and short notes on investigation steps
- Final decision (promote / pin / rollback) + reasoning
- Lessons and follow-ups (Jira links)

End of scratchpad. Will refine into a tidy runbook if this window looks stable. For now: keep this short, actionable, and imperfect.
